title: Let autonomy-next seed a backlog task
summary: When every tracked task is integrated or blocked, let autonomy-next optionally seed the next backlog template so autonomous runs can continue without a separate continuation pass.
expectedFailureModes: Automation dead-ends on autonomy-next even though a backlog template exists.
Seeding produces an invalid task JSON record or bypasses autonomy validation.
Seed mode mutates the task directory without leaving durable evidence in events.
nextAction: Integrated locally; continue with a concrete capability or live-coverage hardening task after commit and push.
